attr.title: Elemental Legends
attr.desc: A young mage awakens at the rune stone and masters fire, ice, storm and earth magic to conquer five elemental lairs and the Dark Tower. A Link to the Past style action RPG with relics, puzzles, caves, side quests and fifteen mini-bosses.
attr.inst: Ready to run. Copy ElementalLegends.sh and the elementallegends folder into your ports folder.
